seo.title: Bitwise Security - Secure File Portal
seo.description: Exchange sensitive documents and security reports through a private, encrypted Bitwise Security client portal.

hero.description: A private route for the documents that should never become ordinary email attachments. Clients can upload sensitive material and receive completed reports through an encrypted, malware-screened workspace.

modes.label: ONGOING ENGAGEMENTS
modes.title: Private client workspace
modes.text: A named client space protected by password and MFA, with a clear separation between documents sent to Bitwise Security and reports shared back.

modes.label: ONE-OFF DELIVERY
modes.title: Password-protected transfer
modes.text: A time-limited download link for recipients who do not need an account. The link and generated password are shared through separate channels.

principles: No public or anonymous file listings
Files are downloaded, never previewed inline

items.title: Choose the recipient
items.text: Use an MFA-protected client space for ongoing work or a seven-day password-protected link for one-off delivery.

items.title: Encrypt before storage
items.text: The browser encrypts file chunks with AES-256-GCM before encrypted object data is written to private storage.

items.title: Quarantine and screen
items.text: Uploads remain unavailable while file-type checks and continuously updated malware signatures screen the content.

items.title: Deliver with control
items.text: Short-lived, single-use download tickets prevent a copied download address from becoming permanent access.

items.title: Track accountability
items.text: Uploads, downloads, deletions, sign-ins and permission changes are recorded in the administrative security log.

items.title: Close the engagement
items.text: Automatic expiry is available per file, and completed client spaces can be permanently removed with explicit confirmation.

security.title: Security without making clients fight the interface
security.text: The portal keeps the sensitive controls behind a straightforward workflow: choose a space, choose a file, and send. Stronger protections such as MFA, object-level authorization, CSRF protection, rate limiting and one-use tickets operate without adding unnecessary decisions for the recipient.
items: Password plus TOTP MFA for accounts

retention.title: Designed for the end of the engagement
retention.text: Sensitive assessment data should not remain online by accident. Files can expire automatically, protected links expire after seven days, and an administrator can permanently delete a completed client space and its stored objects. Minimal content-free audit evidence may be retained for security accountability.

delivery.title: Need to send something sensitive?
delivery.text: Contact Bitwise Security first. You will receive either a private account invitation or a protected transfer link appropriate for the engagement. Never send sensitive assessment material through the normal contact form.
